note: The declared SSH access path per machine, for the fleet observation collector (ticket 01 of fleet-ssh-access). No credentials live here and none may: the destination is an ssh alias, a machine name, or user@host, and it is passed to ssh verbatim. RESOLUTION IS THE COLLECTOR HOST'S: a record declares WHICH machine may be reached; the host that runs the collector holds HOW the credential is presented (User, IdentityFile, IdentitiesOnly, HostName) in its own ~/.ssh/config. A destination that no stanza covers fails as unreachable and is reported, never guessed. A machine with no record here is reported as no-access-record and its readings carry that fact. A record that is malformed, duplicated, or whose serial contradicts the machine's own inventory row is reported and the machine is NOT probed. Everything still uncovered needs its access approved first: see tickets 02-04 of this set.
